unknown: SWE-Bench Pro (Scale, public V2): not listed on Scale's table (11 models, none from DeepSeek)
Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index: no DeepSeek entry readable on the page (scores rendered as not publicly available)

METR 50% time horizon: no DeepSeek V4 or V4.1 model listed; the page's update log names only DeepSeek-R1 (2025-03-06) and DeepSeek-V3 (2025-06-27) among DeepSeek models, and the graph itself did not render in the page text
Terminal-Bench 4.0 on the official tbench.ai leaderboard: the rows did not render in the text read; the independent value is Artificial Analysis's 27%, and the 31.2 is the maker's
pricing_usd_per_mtok: the input and cached-input figures are peak prices; no flat standard rate exists
context_window: the maker says 1M; whether that is 1,000,000 or 1,048,576 tokens is not stated (the card uses 1,000,000, as Artificial Analysis lists it)
access: no cloud-marketplace listing (Bedrock, Vertex, Azure) was confirmed on the maker's pages
benchmarks: the Hugging Face card names no harness for its CyberGym and HLE-with-tools rows, and ExploitGym is not entered; the entered rows are marked not stated
prompting_guides: DeepSeek publishes no prompt-writing guide for V4.x; the listed pages are API usage guides and the prompt-format reference
system_card: DeepSeek publishes no system card; the linked V4.1 technical report has no safety or alignment section
